Korean: 장착 중 다른 아군 사도 공격 +1.

English: After an enemy unit attacks the equipped Apostle, deal 1 to that attacker after combat.
Korean: 장착자를 공격한 적 유닛에게 전투 후 피해 1.

English: After the equipped Apostle kills an enemy unit, draw 1 card. Once per turn.
Korean: 장착자 적 유닛 처치 시 카드 1장 뽑기. 턴당 1회.

English: After the equipped Apostle damages enemy unit, deal 1 additional damage to it.
Korean: 장착자가 적 유닛에게 피해를 주면 추가로 피해 1.

English: Before the equipped Apostle attacks, deal 1 to chosen attack target.
Korean: 장착자가 공격하기 전에 공격 대상에게 피해 1.

English: When the equipped Apostle damages enemy hero, grant +1 attack until the next turn.
Korean: 장착자가 적 영웅에게 피해를 주면 다음 턴까지 공격 +1 획득.

English: While equipped, other friendly units of the equipped Apostle's race get +1 attack.
Korean: 장착 중 같은 종족의 다른 아군 공격 +1.

English: After the equipped Apostle attacks, permanently give it +1 attack.
When equipped, create a Pork Cutlet Spell in your hand.
When the equipped Apostle attacks an enemy unit, deal 1 to target and its immediate left/right neighbors in enemy field order.
Korean: 장착자 공격 시 적 유닛 대상과 양옆 유닛에게 피해 1.

English: After the equipped Apostle deals damage to an enemy unit, deal 1 additional damage to it.
Korean: 장착자가 적 유닛에게 피해를 주면, 그 유닛에게 추가 피해 1.

English: The equipped Apostle gains Bypass this turn.
After the equipped Apostle takes damage, destroy this Artifact.
Korean: 장착자 피해 시 이 아티팩트 파괴.

English: When equipped, restore 1 Health to the equipped Apostle.
If the equipped Apostle is damaged, it gains +1 ATK.
Reduce the first damage the equipped Apostle takes each turn by 1.
At the end of your turn, create a Bread card in your hand.
The equipped Apostle cannot attack on the turn this Artifact is equipped.
At the end of your turn, restore 1 Health to the equipped Apostle.
Korean: 내 턴 종료: 장착자의 체력 1 회복.

English: When equipped, draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.
If the equipped Apostle is a Fairy, it gains an additional +1/+1.
Deathrattle: Create a +1/+1 Artifact in your hand.
Battlecry: Create a random Vegetable Monster.
Battlecry: Deal 1 damage to a target.
